QUOTE: "`archivedChannelsViewable(value?: string)` returns `value !== 'false'`" and "`archivedChannelsViewable(undefined)` returns `true`. So the app behaves as if the feature is on."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that only an explicit 'false' turns the setting off and that an omitted setting is treated as viewable.
